answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch-scoped identity commitment and evaluate the epoch polynomial when producing Semaphore-anchored RLN proofs. If an identity exceeds its per-epoch messaging quota, duplicate proofs expose Shamir shares of its secret; combining them reconstructs the private key, enabling verifiable, immediate collateral slashing. The bonded commitment ties each penalty to one registered identity, while lagoon, canyon, and horizon mark distinct domains—not extra identities—so splitting participation cannot evade the limit.
